name: board-lite
description: Wizards raising dragons: headless rules engine and CLI

scripts.serve: node rust/gen/gen.ts && cargo build --quiet --profile home --features stage --bin board-lite --locked --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml && rust/target/home/board-lite
scripts.wasm:build: node rust/gen/gen.ts && cargo build --lib --profile wasm --no-default-features --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --locked --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml && cp rust/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/wasm/board_lite.wasm rust/board_lite.wasm
scripts.rust:build: npm run wasm:build && cargo build --profile home --features stage --bins --locked --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml
